title: 前台②：课程咨询
titleEn: We have a free trial class
goal: 家长来问课程时，能问孩子的年龄和年级，介绍试听课、上课时间和学费。

chunks.note: 新加坡说 Primary 1（小一）、P1。男孩就说 Which level is he in?

chunks.en: We have a free trial class.
chunks.note: trial class = 试听课，free = 免费。

chunks.en: The class is on Saturday at 10am.

chunks.note: $280 读作 two hundred and eighty dollars。

chunks.en: Can I have your phone number?
chunks.zh: 可以给我你的电话号码吗？

chunks.note: 新加坡人常常把 WhatsApp 当动词用，意思是"发 WhatsApp 消息"。

frames.usage: 问对方想不想做一件事，也可以用来客气地邀请。框不变，把要做的事放进 ___。

examples.scene: 家长听完试听课的介绍，看起来有点兴趣。
下班后你要去 hawker centre 吃晚饭，问一起住的朋友。
在 MRT 上，一位老人家站在你旁边，你站起来让座。
examples.en: Do you want to sit here?

examples.scene: 家长报完名，你问他是不是现在交学费。
examples.en: Do you want to pay now?

examples.scene: 周末你和朋友们在公园野餐，看到住楼上的邻居路过。
examples.en: Do you want to join us?
examples.note: join us = 加入我们、和我们一起

examples.scene: 刚搬了新家，朋友在电话里问你新家怎么样。
examples.en: Do you want to see my new home?
examples.zh: 你想来看看我的新家吗？
accept: Do you want to come and see my new home?

examples.scene: 家里来了客人，大热天刚进门。
examples.en: Do you want to drink some water?
accept: Do you want to drink water?

examples.scene: 家长想知道孩子上课的情况，老师刚好下课出来。
examples.en: Do you want to speak to the teacher?
accept: Do you want to talk to the teacher?

examples.scene: 家长在电话里问试听课，你问他要不要先约一节。
examples.en: Do you want to book a trial class?
examples.zh: 你要预约一节试听课吗？

examples.scene: 周末早上你要去巴刹买菜，问家里人要不要一起去。
examples.en: Do you want to go to the market with me?
examples.zh: 你要和我一起去巴刹吗？

daily.scene: 在 HDB 楼下，邻居问你儿子几岁了。
白天朋友打电话来，问你女儿在不在家。
daily.en: My daughter is at school now.

daily.scene: 新搬来的邻居问附近有没有小学。
daily.en: The school is near my home.

daily.scene: 邻居的女儿说她才十八岁，已经在打工了。
朋友问你为什么每天晚上都戴着耳机听东西。
周末天气很热，你问朋友想不想去游泳。
daily.en: Do you want to go swimming?

daily.scene: 新认识的朋友问你会不会做饭。
早上出门，邻居说她也要去 MRT 站。
朋友问你周末一般去哪里散步。
daily.en: The park is near my home.

daily.scene: 新认识的朋友问你爸爸妈妈是不是也在新加坡。
邻居阿姨很会包粽子，你也想学。
朋友第一次和你来 hawker centre，看起来什么都很新鲜。

lines.en: It's Saturday. I'm not busy today.
I call my friend.
"Do you want to go swimming?"
We go swimming together at noon.
The weather is very hot.
I'm not very good at swimming.
It's my first time.
My friend can teach me.
Now we are very hungry.
We have chicken rice near the park.
lines.zh: 我们在公园附近吃鸡饭。

lines.en: "Do you want to come again on Sunday?"
Yes! I want to learn swimming.

dialogue.title: 奶奶来问课
dialogue.setting: 星期三下午，一位奶奶走进补习中心，想给孙子报华文课。

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Hi! Do you have a Chinese class?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes, we have. How old is your child?

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: He is 6. I'm his grandma.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Which level is he in?

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Sorry, can you say that again?
lines.zh: 不好意思，可以再说一遍吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Which level is he in? Is he in school?

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: No. He is very young.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: We have a free trial class. Do you want to try?
lines.zh: 我们有免费试听课。想试一下吗？

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Yes. What time is the class?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The class is on Saturday at 10am.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: How much is the fee?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The fee is $280 a month.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: It's very expensive!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The first class is free!

grammar.title: $280 a month 就是"每个月 280"
grammar.body: 价格或者次数后面加 a month / a week，意思是"每个月 / 每星期"。这里的 a 不是"一个"，而是"每"。

dialogue.title: 家长来问华文课
dialogue.setting: 一位妈妈走进补习中心，想给女儿报华文课。

npc.en: Hi, I want to ask about Chinese classes for my daughter.
npc.zh: 你好，我想问一下我女儿的华文课。

replies.en: We have a free trial class.
We have a free trial class. Do you want to try?
replies.zh: 我们有免费试听课。你想试一下吗？

npc.en: Oh good. When is the class?
npc.zh: 哦，太好了。什么时候上课？

replies.en: The class is on Saturday at 10am.
It's on Saturday at 10am. Do you want to see the classroom?
replies.zh: 星期六早上十点。你想看看教室吗？

npc.en: Okay, I think we can try.

replies.en: Can I have your phone number?
replies.zh: 可以给我你的电话号码吗？

replies.en: Thank you. I will WhatsApp you.
replies.zh: 谢谢，我会发 WhatsApp 给你。

npc.en: Thank you, see you on Saturday!

task: 今天有家长来问课程时，试着用英语说一句 We have a free trial class.
